items.followUp: State two benefits of transpiration to plants.

rubric.why: Shows the harmful effect that makes transpiration an evil.
rubric.description: Excessive water loss can cause wilting.
rubric.how: Award for linking excessive water loss with wilting.

rubric.description: Transpiration cools the plant and helps move water and mineral salts upward.
rubric.how: Award for naming at least one benefit of transpiration, such as cooling or the upward movement of water and mineral salts.

modelAnswer: Transpiration is called an evil because excessive water loss may cause a plant to wilt.
It is necessary because it cools the plant and helps the upward movement of water and mineral salts.
